testBenchNotes: Initial CLI invocation used the wrong working directory; actual run used the project-installed Playwright from frontend.
Initial upgrade safety guard stopped before reset/install because AVD output contained an extra carriage return. Trimmed the captured name, retained the exact AVD-name guard and reran successfully.
limits: Native runs are AOSP emulators, not physical Xiaomi/Samsung firmware benchmarks.
Upgrade used Android in-place APK installation via adb, not the unpublished 1.2.16 update feed.
Support delivery is captured SMTP; deletion-request entry is verified, not actual erasure.
Gateway method tests use isolated provider fixtures; no live payment settlement or external messages.
